name: io.github.devchad-cmd/skilldb
title: SkillDB
description: Search and load AI agent skills. Free metadata; full content requires a Pro or Studio account.

runtimeArguments.description: Makes the following generated skilldb@0.8.3 identifier an npm package selection; the command is skilldb-mcp.

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP binary from the selected package instead of the interactive SkillDB CLI.

environmentVariables.name: SKILLDB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional for local metadata search; full skill content requires a Pro or Studio API key. Get a key at skilldb.dev/api-access.

dev.skilldb.releaseNotes: Registry metadata repair only; npm and server software remain 0.8.3. Uses the canonical OAuth resource URL, correct npm binary selection, current access copy, and the shared SkillDB logo.
dev.skilldb.remoteAuthentication: OAuth or a SkillDB API key is required for the full remote integration. The separate anonymous SkillDB Catalog only searches public metadata and short previews.
